verdict.rationale: Bolna's public GitHub repository describes the product as an open source framework, so its core source is readable. The evidence never names the license or says whether the hosted platform (dashboard, Agent Studio, workflows) is covered, so the open-license half of the story is only asserted. missing for 10: a named OSI-approved license in the evidence, clarity on whether the full hosted platform source (beyond the framework) is published, independent corroboration of license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Bolna is the end-to-end open source production ready framework for quickly building LLM based voice driven conversational applications.
Learn how to self-host Bolna Voice AI on your own servers using Docker or Kubernetes
